hook: A world model guesses what happens next, without running the real thing.
definition: A neural network that is given the current frame and an action, then predicts the next frame and the reward.
example: On a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, a world model draws the game frames. The player network sees only those frames, never the game.
the_catch: It is not a copy of the game. Agents trained only inside the dream scored 210 there, but 28 in the real game.
caption: A world model is a neural network that predicts the next frame and reward from the current frame and an action. In one Pico 2 W project, the player never touches the real game, and a Breakout agent still found a way to exploit the dream. Would you trust a dream to teach you a game?
alt_text: A five-slide glossary carousel defining a world model: a neural network that predicts the next frame and reward from the current frame and an action, an example from an earlier gummietech post about games generated on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, and the common mistake of treating it as a copy of the real game.

es.hook: Un modelo de mundo adivina lo que ocurrirá a continuación, sin ejecutar el entorno real.
es.definition: Una red neuronal a la que se le suministra el fotograma actual y una acción, y que predice el siguiente fotograma y la recompensa.
es.example: En una Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, un modelo de mundo genera los fotogramas del juego. La red del jugador solo ve esos fotogramas, nunca el juego.
es.the_catch: No es una copia del juego. Los agentes entrenados únicamente dentro del sueño obtuvieron 210 allí, pero solo 28 en el juego real.
